summary: Full backend + frontend testing of T.E.R.E.S.A. MVP. All 28 pytest backend tests PASS (100%) — auth, readings, sessions, alerts, contacts, calendar, doctor role, and wound-photo AI analysis via Emergent LLM Key (GPT-5.2 vision) all functional. Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844) confirmed: register→login→home flow, bottom tabs (Home/Calendário/Avisos/Perfil) navigation, drawer with all 5 items (Configurações/Conectar/Sobre/Ajuda/Privacidade), TopBar hamburger+bell, calendar prev/next with legend, empty states, Edit Profile modal (7 fields+Salvar), Add Contact modal, logout — all rendering & functional. React-Native-Web deprecation warnings present (shadow*, pointerEvents) — non-blocking but should be addressed.

ui_bugs.issue: No testID on the primary 'Salvar' button inside edit profile modal — hard for E2E tests to verify save flow
No testID on 'Adicionar' button inside new-contact modal
Close icon inside modal has no testID

issues: TextInputs render as empty pill shapes without visible border/placeholder value — user may not realize the field is tappable until focused. Consider adding placeholder text or a subtle border.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted repeatedly on every screen load. Reference: any StyleSheet using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (e.g. Card.tsx, home.tsx metric cards).

React-Native-Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Likely inside AppDrawer backdrop / Modal wrappers. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AppDrawer.tsx (backdrop View).

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props with `boxShadow` for React-Native-Web compatibility (visual identical on native, silences RNW warnings).
Optional: replace `pointerEvents` prop with `style={{pointerEvents:'...'}}` on the AppDrawer backdrop and any Modal wrappers.
Optional (nice-to-have for future tests): add testIDs to primary modal buttons — Salvar (edit profile), Adicionar (new contact), and modal close (X) icons.
Optional UX: give the Edit Profile TextInputs a visible border or placeholder text so users see the tappable area.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: correctly excludes MongoDB `_id` in all reads. bcrypt + JWT auth, env-var driven, no hardcoded secrets. Well structured (~730 lines) — still within acceptable range but approaching the 700-line split threshold if more endpoints are added.
Frontend: all interactive elements have testID on primary buttons/tabs/drawer; only nested modal-primary buttons lack them (see ui_bugs).
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly for the API base; no hardcoded URLs found.
All text is wrapped in <Text>; StyleSheet.create used throughout; no HTML div/span/p in RN screens.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Ephemeral TEST_/e2e_ users created during pytest and Playwright runs; they persist in MongoDB (teresa_app.users) but are namespaced by prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://wound-healing-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Frontend served at same origin. All /api routes tested & passing. Wound-photo analyze endpoint DOES successfully call Emergent LLM Key GPT-5.2 vision and returns structured JSON (occasionally litellm may report 'Budget exceeded' — transient; retry). Use a real JPEG from /tmp/wound_small.jpg (300x169 photo from Unsplash) for analyze tests — solid-color images are not allowed per /app/image_testing.md. Playwright: use mobile viewport 390x844 and testIDs listed in the grep output for each screen.
rca_of_issue: No functional issues detected. Only two non-blocking React-Native-Web deprecation warnings and three missing testIDs on modal primary buttons — all Optional / LOW priority.
